title: Local cumulative acceptance and current evidence seal
purpose: Execute the exact ordered 75-gate suite and seal one current candidate acceptance claim without upgrading external runtime gates.
entry_condition: Clean exact-byte checkout of candidate with pre-bound mutable current candidate claim.

transitions.action: Run next exact gate/script pair and verify runtime/tree authority did not mutate
Any gate returns nonzero or authority mutates
All 75 exact ordered pairs pass under FRESH_FULL
Rotate only canonical mutable current acceptance claim/report identity

invariants: Exactly 75 ordered gate/script results are required.
Source-tree and suite signatures must match candidate evidence.
Local PASS does not set external runtime gates to PASS.
failure_behavior: First gate/evidence mismatch is terminal for the run; stale candidate binding fails current-evidence sync.
restart_behavior: Fresh rerun produces new report identity while historical repair evidence remains immutable.
rollback_behavior: Failed run does not alter accepted source authority.
